L3Harris Technologies is hiring an Associate, Software Engineering to develop embedded software for real-time control of high-power and high-energy power conversion equipment. The role supports the software development life cycle, software testing, and collaboration across hardware and software engineering.

Responsibilities
Apply computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis concepts and principles in the development of software for the target application
Work closely with cross functional members of the engineering organization to develop and evaluate interfaces between hardware and software, and operational performance requirements and design of the overall system
Support and participate in all phases of the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, and test of embedded software for real-time control of high power and high energy power conversion equipment
Develop and execute software test procedures, software programs, and related documentation
Utilize modeling tools and equipment to establish operating data, conduct experimental tests, and evaluate results
Participate in peer reviews, pull request, identify, track and resolve SW defects
Utilize a variety of software languages (i.e., C, C++, Python, MATLAB)
